subject: Re: Annual capacity reserve invoicing & VAT mapping (PO integrated)
messages:
From: Amelia Rios <amelia.rios@bluebay.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-03T08:17:00+01:00
Subject: Annual prepay — invoicing schedule for 2027 capacity reserve

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. Finance asked me to confirm the invoicing cadence for the annual committed capacity we discussed (roughly €1.2M commitment). Two quick asks from our side:

1) A clear invoice schedule we can attach to the PO (BlueBay PO 7789).
2) How Redwood expects VAT to be handled for UK/IE entities (we'll attach VAT certs).

Do you have a recommended drawdown pattern (monthly, quarterly) and any sample invoice layout we can show our AP team? We want to avoid manual rework on our side.

If it's easier, we can supply the PO and VAT certs once we align the schedule.

Thanks,
Amelia
Amelia Rios
Finance Lead, BlueBay Analytics
amelia.rios@bluebay.com
[Attachment: BlueBay_PO_7789.pdf]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Amelia Rios <amelia.rios@bluebay.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T11:02:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — invoicing schedule for 2027 capacity reserve

Hi Amelia — thanks for the note. Happy to lock this in. Proposed approach (keeps AP and our ledger tidy):

- Invoice 1 (activation): 50% upfront at contract effective date.
- Subsequent drawdowns: monthly top-ups tied to token consumption, invoiced at month-end, with a quarterly reconciliation to the committed balance.
- Reserve sweep: if monthly consumption < 10% of expected run-rate for three consecutive months, automatic top-up trigger to restore to minimum reserve (configurable).

Operational items we need from you: PO number (we have 7789 attached), the VAT certificate for the billing entity (attach), and confirmation of the billing legal entity (Redwood will bill from Redwood EU SARL if you want intra-EU reverse charge otherwise our US entity).

We will:
- Tag every invoice with the PO and a dedicated GL code (e.g., BB-CR-1179)
- Include a one-line drawdown ledger extract with each invoice showing opening committed balance, drawdown amount, and remaining credit
- Provide a monthly CSV export for your accounting team (automated).

I've attached a sample invoice layout so you can share with AP. If that works, we'll issue Invoice #RWD-202705-A (50%) once we receive the signed order and PO confirmation.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redwood-invoice-sample-202705.pdf]

From: Amelia Rios <amelia.rios@bluebay.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-04T09:22:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay — invoicing schedule for 2027 capacity reserve

Thanks — that schedule is clear and should be fine. A couple of clarifications from AP:

- We will provide PO 7789 formally this afternoon (attached).
- VAT: BlueBay UK will supply the VAT certificate; our tax team would prefer intra-EU reverse charge where possible. We'll attach VAT_Certificate_UK_2026.pdf.
- For the monthly CSV: can the file include both token usage and monetary drawdown columns? AP wants a one-row-per-invoice detail plus cumulative committed balance.

I'll attach the certs and the PO now. Expect a short follow-up from our accountant (Tom) with one question about bank remittance reference format.

Best,
Amelia
[Attachment: BlueBay_PO_7789.pdf] [Attachment: VAT_Certificate_UK_2026.pdf]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Amelia Rios <amelia.rios@bluebay.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T11:05:00+01:00
Subject: FW: Annual prepay — invoicing schedule for 2027 capacity reserve

Kimberly / Logan — please action below. Key asks:

- Prepare the activation invoice (50%) ready to send upon PO confirmation; invoice must include PO 7789 and GL tag BB-CR-1179.
- Create monthly CSV template: columns = invoice_id, invoice_date, token_usage, drawdown_amount, opening_committed_balance, closing_committed_balance, PO_number.
- Add VAT handling note: default to Redwood EU SARL billing; if AP confirms reverse charge, include VAT = 0 line with reverse-charge note and VAT certificate reference.
- Set the reserve sweep trigger rule in billing ops (threshold: 10% of expected run-rate, 3 months sustained).

Can you confirm ETA on the activation invoice and the CSV automation?

Thanks,
Karthik

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-05T09:14:00+01:00
Subject: Re: FW: Annual prepay — invoicing schedule for 2027 capacity reserve

Acknowledged.

- Activation invoice draft: will be ready EOD 2027-05-05; will use PO 7789 and include the GL tag.
- CSV export: we will include token_usage + monetary drawdown + cumulative balance; automation scheduled to run on the 1st of each month (first run 2027-06-01).
- VAT: we will default to Redwood EU SARL and include a reverse-charge line if BlueBay confirms cross-border intra-EU treatment (we'll reference VAT_Certificate_UK_2026.pdf in the invoice footer).
- Attachment: sample invoice attached for preview.

We'll also add a short note to AP about the remittance reference format: please use "RWD-BB-1179-INV#" so reconciliation is automatic.

Thanks — Kimberly
